name: Search real movie titles and open details
covers: illustrated poster fallback when no image is available
description: Verifies visitors can search for a real film and read its curated details.
expected: Interstellar appears with its real release year, cast, original synopsis, trailer control and external reference links. Its official poster image appears when the film page provides one; otherwise the illustrated fallback remains. No demo-rating claim is shown.

name: Filter the real catalogue by genre
description: Verifies the expanded catalogue has at least five films in every existing genre and genre filtering still works.
steps: Select Mystery from Movie Genres and count the visible film cards
expected: Mystery has at least five films including Knives Out, Se7en, Zodiac, Memento and Gone Girl; Animation includes Spirited Away, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, Toy Story, Coco and WALL-E, with unrelated genres filtered out.

name: Open movie research and watch links
description: Verifies movie details include external research and availability search links.
steps: Find the Explore this film links
Open IMDb, Wikipedia, YouTube trailers and JustWatch links in separate tabs
expected: Each link opens a search for the selected real movie; streaming is presented as a search, not a guaranteed provider listing.

name: Find and play a YouTube trailer or see fallback
description: Verifies the trailer feature uses the selected real movie title and year and provides an honest fallback.
steps: Immediately check that a YouTube trailer link is available while embedded lookup runs
Play the thumbnail if a match appears, or use the direct YouTube fallback
expected: The movie preview shows only a thumbnail or fallback movie artwork with a centered play icon, without trailer headings, captions, or status text; a relevant embeddable video plays in-page when a match is returned.

name: Save a curated film to the session watchlist
description: Verifies the existing watchlist still works with real catalogue records.
steps: Verify the saved state and header count
expected: Parasite is marked saved and the watchlist count increases for the current session.
